_doc: Wiki page types, id conventions and update rules (ARCHITECTURE.md §2.1, §2.7, §2.8 step 2). Read by the ingest (§2.3) and query code; nothing here is hardcoded inline.

page_id.convention: kebab-case slug derived from the page's concept/title, unique per user

page_types.description: Name, age, pronouns, where they live now, where they're from.
Work, studies, ambitions, how they spend their days.
Family of origin, siblings, kids, closeness, obligations.
Relationship history, what they're looking for, patterns.
Hard nos and non-negotiables for a partner.
Beliefs, politics, faith, ethics, what matters to them.
Temperament, humour, communication style, how they show up.
Hobbies, passions, tastes, what they do for fun.
Daily rhythm, health, substances, money habits, travel.
Life goals, timelines, kids/marriage intent, where they're headed.
Health, trauma, finances, anything the user hasn't chosen to make public.
Standing instructions the user gave about how Ayma should talk to them (topics to avoid, style). Ayma-managed.
Anything real that doesn't fit another type yet.

rules: A page's visibility starts from its page_type default and is only widened (toward public) on clear signal the user is open about it.
Wiki content derived from DM images or DM voice notes defaults to ai_only (§2.3) — the user already holds the raw content in the thread.
ai_only pages are never returned to any client, owner or not, and never read by the matching skill (§2.1).

fields.ai_body: AI-authored markdown, the compiled source of truth. Rewritten in place on ingest, never appended, never mutated by user edits.
fields.frontmatter: map of structured fields for the matching Pass-1 filter (e.g. age, location, intent) — lives on the page beside the narrative body
fields.image_refs: array of Firebase Storage URLs for photos relevant to this page; the caption is woven into ai_body, this is the pointer to the file
fields.user_edits: optional user-authored override markdown; rendered instead of ai_body in the user's own views. Set only by the client edit path.
fields.user_hidden: boolean; the user removed this page from their own view. ai_body is retained regardless. Set only by the client edit path.
fields.lint_flags: array of { type, detail, flagged_at } written by the Lint job (§2.3). Never auto-resolved.
fields.source_turn_ids: array of raw_turns doc ids that contributed to this page — every claim in ai_body should trace to at least one

update_rules: Ingest creates a page when a concept has no existing page; otherwise it revises that page's ai_body in place.
ai_body is a compiled narrative, not a log: rewrite it to stay current and coherent, do not append.
Ingest and Lint never write user_edits or user_hidden; the client edit path never writes ai_body.
On every write, refresh updated_at and union the contributing raw_turns ids into source_turn_ids.

raw_turns_extension.image_refs: array of Firebase Storage URLs shared during the session

pending_questions._doc: Task state, not compiled knowledge (§2.4). No visibility tier — never shown to the user.

fields.question_text: string — the question Ayma would ask
fields.category: string — the wiki page_type an answer would inform
fields.target_page: optional page_id an answer would update
